title: The yaml block of a layout 2 build log entry

commits.description: Commit hashes. A hash of digits only is read by YAML as an integer; the reader converts it back to text.

departure.description: Free text, any characters, any number of lines. Omitted when there is none.

red.description: Whether the task's failing test was seen to fail before any production code: `observed`, or `not observed: <reason>`. Omitted when the entry does not say; the reader then returns null.

notes.description: Choices the task's text left open. Free text, any characters, any number of lines. Omitted when there are none. The reader does not return it.
